title: Whose Side Are You On?
excerpt: This week many people around the world are recalling – with a wide range of emotion and opinion – the formation of the modern state of Israel 60 years ago. This piece by Eboo Patel expresses what’s most in my heart these days. Blessed are the peacemakers …
body:
This week many people around the world are recalling – with a wide range of emotion and opinion – the formation of the modern state of Israel 60 years ago.

 This piece by Eboo Patel expresses what’s most in my heart these days.

Blessed are the peacemakers …
